Key observations from the test image:
- Soybean leaf with dark brown/black spots in lower-left area
- Yellow halo visible around the dark spots
- Small central lesion near middle appears to be falling out (shot hole)
- Otherwise mostly green leaf

Top candidates: **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (shot hole, reddish-brown borders, yellow halo), **Bacterial_Blight** (angular, yellow-green halos), **Septoria_brown_spot** (angular brown spots).

Let me view reference images:
Frogeye shows the best match so far — round/oval spots with shot holes on green leaves. Let me check a few more candidates:

The Frogeye_leaf_spot reference (top-right panel) shows nearly identical round dark spots with shot holes on green leaves — matching the test image well. Phyllosticta also has some similarity. Let me check a few more to confirm:

Downy mildew, soybean rust, and Cercospora are all ruled out — none match the pattern in the test image.

**Summary of analysis:**

- **Test image**: Mostly green soybean leaf lying on soil. A few round/oval dark brown-to-black spots in the lower-left area with distinct yellow halos. One small tan lesion near the center shows a shot hole (center fallen out). Sparse, discrete lesions — not numerous.

- **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (best match): Reference shows round dark spots on green leaves, some with shot holes where centers fall out, with brownish-purple borders. The top-right panel of the Frogeye reference is nearly identical to the test image.

- **Bacterial_Blight**: Shows smaller, more angular, more numerous yellow-green lesions — doesn't match the discrete round dark spots.

- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Many more spots, angular, heavy yellowing — doesn't match.

- **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot**: Gray/tan lesions with darker margins — the color is lighter/more tan than the dark spots in the test image.

The combination of round/circular dark spots, yellow halos, and shot hole appearance strongly points to Frogeye_leaf_spot.

The Frogeye reference images show nearly identical round dark spots on green leaves with shot holes.
